# HexPiece 3.5.4

Birdcage fix (the Ito fruit, N). Not tested in game yet: the build and the tests pass.

- Closing the cage (N again) no longer freezes everyone inside or drags them to the middle. Inside the cage, everyone moves freely the
  whole time.
- Only the cage's strings do anything: touching them cuts you, and as the cage closes its wall sweeps you in along with it. You can
  still slide sideways along the wall and move away from it.
- When the cage fully shuts, everyone it caught takes the full damage and bleeds, then they are free.
- The standing cage is unchanged: its strings cut whoever touches them and push them back in, or keep them out.
